# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it responsibly:

- **Email**: security@lemonlion.dev
- **GitHub**: Open a [private security advisory](https://github.com/lemonlion/InMemoryEmulator.Bigtable/security/advisories/new)

## Response Timeline

- **Acknowledgment**: Within 48 hours
- **Fix/mitigation**: Within 7 days

## Scope

- Dependency vulnerabilities
- GoogleSQL parser injection
- gRPC service vulnerabilities

## Note

This is a **testing fake** — it is not intended for production use and does not handle real authentication, authorization, or sensitive data. Security vulnerabilities in the emulator are lower severity than typical production software, but we still take them seriously.
